title: Knockout Questions: The Real Reason You're Not Getting Hired
description:
Every career coach has been telling you ATS software is rejecting your CV. They are wrong, and it is costing you interviews every week. In this video I break down the 3 things actually filtering your applications out, backed by data from 1.7 million real applications and recruiters at Amazon, Microsoft, and Fortune 500 companies, plus 6 years of selling and configuring ATS software inside employers like Morgan Stanley.

You will see why no major ATS (Workday, Greenhouse, Ashby) auto-rejects your CV, the knockout questions filtering you out before upload, the 6-second human scan that decides yes / no / maybe, and why AI-polished CVs scream fake to recruiters. Plus the exact change one of my students used to go from being ignored to a 26% application-to-interview rate.
